picks.editorial_note: Purdue leading two of the first DOE Genesis Mission awards signals a major new federal push to use AI for accelerating scientific discovery, with real funding and infrastructure implications.
picks.title: 2 Purdue AI research projects selected among the first Genesis Mission awards

picks.editorial_note: A second Genesis Mission award, this time pairing Alabama with Fermilab, shows the new DOE AI initiative is spreading funding and partnerships across multiple institutions and scientific domains from its very first round.
picks.title: AI meets particle physics in UA-Led Department of Energy project

picks.editorial_note: A £20 million MRC-funded hub at Cambridge combining stem cell models with AI represents a substantial, well-funded bet on AI-accelerated drug development.
picks.title: Cambridge to lead new £20m MRC Hub to transform development of new medicines using stem cells and AI

picks.editorial_note: HappyRobot crossing a $1 billion valuation as TUM's 23rd unicorn is a concrete commercial validation of AI research spinning out of a major university.
picks.title: HappyRobot is TUM's 23rd unicorn

picks.editorial_note: An ARPA-H-funded collaboration between SRI, Mayo Clinic, and the University of Florida to guide medical procedures with AI-enabled smart glasses is a notable real-world clinical application backed by a major federal partnership.
picks.title: AI guides healthcare workers through blood draws, intubation, and more - SRI

picks.editorial_note: UCLA's use of generative AI to design entirely novel proteins, building on Nobel Prize-winning techniques, represents a genuine scientific advance with broad biomedical potential.
picks.title: UCLA bioengineer Jason Zhang deploys AI to create proteins never before seen in nature

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's VirTues foundation model for spatial tumor mapping across cancer types could meaningfully improve treatment response prediction, a significant step for AI in oncology.
picks.title: AI model maps tumor tissue to improve cancer care

picks.title: The Hebrew University of Jerusalem Congratulates Prof. Haim Sompolinsky on Receiving the 2026 Dirac Medal
